tools.name: getAdvice
tools.description: Returns one random piece of life advice, drawn from a set of over 5000 entries. Takes no parameters and returns a different result each call.

tools.name: getAirQuality
tools.description: Returns the Air Quality Index plus CO, NO2, O3, SO2, PM2.5 and PM10 concentrations for a location. Requires a `city` or `lat`/`lon`; `state` and `country` disambiguate city names. Searching by `city` is premium only; free-tier requests can use `lat`/`lon`.

tools.name: getAircraft
tools.description: Returns airplane specs matching the given filters, or decodes an ICAO (icao=A20N) or IATA (iata=32N) aircraft type code. At least one parameter other than limit is required. Helicopter specs: /v1/helicopter.

tools.name: getAirlines
tools.description: Returns general and fleet information for airlines matching an ICAO code, IATA code, or name. At least one of `icao`, `iata`, or `name` must be set.

tools.name: getAirports
tools.description: Returns airports matching filters such as IATA/ICAO code, name, city, country, region, elevation, size, or runway length. `name`, `city`, `region` and `q` are premium only; the other filters, `limit` and `offset` work on any plan. For typeahead suggestions use /airportsuggest.

tools.name: getAirportsList
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of airport codes and names. For filtered airport detail use /airports. Requires a premium subscription.

tools.name: convertAirportCode
tools.description: Converts an airport code between IATA and ICAO. Pass exactly one of `iata`, `icao`, or `code` (auto-detected). Requires a premium subscription.

tools.name: airportDistance
tools.description: Calculates great-circle distance, initial bearing, and estimated flight time between two airports. Requires `from` and `to`. Requires a premium subscription.

tools.name: airportSuggest
tools.description: Returns autocomplete suggestions for airport search, matching IATA, ICAO, name, and city. Requires a `q` of at least 2 characters. Requires a premium subscription.

tools.name: closestAirport
tools.description: Returns the airports nearest a coordinate, sorted by airport size then by distance. Requires `lat` and `lon`. Requires a premium subscription.

tools.name: getAnalytics
tools.description: Returns usage analytics and API call history for your own account, including which APIs you call most. Requires `api_key` as a query parameter. Calls here do not consume quota.

tools.name: getAnimals
tools.description: Returns scientific facts about animal species whose common name matches the search term, including partial matches. Requires `name`.

tools.name: getBabyNames
tools.description: Returns baby names, optionally filtered by `gender` (boy, girl or neutral). By default only popular names, the top 10%, are returned; set popular_only to false for the full pool.

tools.name: getBalanceSheet
tools.description: Returns balance sheet data from SEC 10-Q and 10-K filings for one company, fiscal period and year. Requires `ticker` or `cik`. For which periods exist use /balancesheetavailability.

tools.name: getBalanceSheetAvailability
tools.description: Returns the fiscal years and quarters for which balance sheet data is available for a company. Requires a premium subscription (Developer tier and above).

tools.name: getBankHolidays
tools.description: Returns bank holidays for a country and calendar year. Requires a `country`. To test a single date use /isbankholiday.

tools.name: isBankHoliday
tools.description: Checks whether banks are closed nationwide on a given date in a country, or in one of its regions when `subdivision` is given. Requires `date` and `country`. For a whole year's calendar use /bankholidays.

tools.name: generateBarcode
tools.description: Generates a barcode image encoding `text`. Optional `type`, `format` and `include_text` control the symbology and output. Requires `text`.

tools.name: binLookup
tools.description: Returns bank and issuer information for a Bank Identification Number. Requires a `bin`, typically the first 6-8 digits of a credit card number.

tools.name: getBitcoinData
tools.description: Returns the latest Bitcoin price and market data. Takes no parameters. For a price series over a past time range use /bitcoinhistorical.

tools.name: getBitcoinHistoricalData
tools.description: Returns historical Bitcoin price data over a chosen interval and Unix timestamp range. For the latest price instead use /bitcoin.

tools.name: getBitcoinTreasury
tools.description: Bitcoin positions reported to the SEC in quarterly XBRL filings, covering operating companies and spot bitcoin exchange-traded products. Each position is as of the filer's reported period end. For holdings in other crypto assets use /v1/cryptotreasury.

tools.name: getBsbInfo
tools.description: Looks up the bank, branch, address and supported payment systems for a 6-digit Australian BSB number. Requires `bsb`. To find a BSB by bank or location use /bsbsearch.

tools.name: searchBsb
tools.description: Finds Australian bank branches and their BSB numbers by bank name, suburb, state or postcode. To look up a single BSB number already known use /bsblookup.

tools.name: getBucketListItem
tools.description: Returns one randomly chosen bucket list idea. Takes no parameters, so call it again for a different suggestion.

tools.name: calculateCaloriesBurned
tools.description: Calculates calories burned from an activity, weight in pounds, and duration in minutes. Requires an activity. For valid names use /caloriesburnedactivities. The image_url and icon_url fields are premium only.

tools.name: listActivities
tools.description: Returns the names of all activities supported by the calories-burned calculation. To compute calories for one of them use /caloriesburned.

tools.name: getCanadaRoutingNumberInfo
tools.description: Returns the Canadian bank branch for a 9-digit EFT `routing_number`, or for a `transit_number` plus `institution_number`. To search by name or location use /canadaroutingnumbersearch.

tools.name: searchCanadaRoutingNumbers
tools.description: Finds Canadian bank branches and their routing numbers by bank name, city, province or postal code. To decode a known routing number use /canadaroutingnumber. Requires a premium subscription.

tools.name: getCars
tools.description: The main endpoint. Search the whole catalogue by any combination of filters, or fetch cars you already know with id/ids. Every car is returned with its complete specification sheet attached, so no second call is needed. Each row also carries its own make, model, generation, body and engine context.

tools.name: getCarFacets
tools.description: Builds every dependent dropdown in one request instead of one request per level. Facets narrow with whatever is already selected. Available on every plan, including Free.

tools.name: getCarMakes
tools.description: Lists car manufacturers available in the catalogue. Use it to populate a make selector before calling /carmodels. Requires a paid plan (Premium).

tools.name: getCarModels
tools.description: Lists the models belonging to a given manufacturer. Pair with /carmakes upstream and /cargenerations downstream. Requires a paid plan (Premium).

tools.name: getCarGenerations
tools.description: The level most vehicle APIs do not expose. Optional: nothing downstream requires it. Generations with no cars are returned with car_count 0 so gaps are visible. Requires a Business or Professional plan, or any annual plan.

tools.name: getCashFlow
tools.description: Returns cash flow statement data from SEC 10-Q and 10-K filings for one company, fiscal period and year. Requires `ticker` or `cik`. For available periods use /cashflowavailability.

tools.name: getCashFlowAvailability
tools.description: Returns the fiscal years and quarters for which cash flow data is available for a company. Requires a premium subscription (Developer tier and above).

tools.name: getCats
tools.description: Returns cat breeds matching the given parameters, including weight, life expectancy, shedding, grooming and friendliness traits. For breed names only use /allcats.

tools.name: getAllCatNames
tools.description: Returns the names of every cat breed in the database and nothing else. Takes no parameters. For full breed detail and filtering use /cats.

tools.name: getCelebrity
tools.description: Returns celebrity records with net worth, profession, and birthday, filtered by name, net worth range, nationality, or height in meters.

tools.name: getChuckNorrisJoke
tools.description: Returns one random Chuck Norris joke. Takes no parameters. For jokes on other topics such as pop culture, science or history use /jokes.

tools.name: getCityData
tools.description: Get city data from either a name or population range. Returns a list of cities that satisfies the parameters.

tools.name: searchCocktails
tools.description: Searches cocktail recipes by name, with partial matches, or by a comma-separated ingredient list that returns only drinks containing every listed ingredient.

tools.name: getCurrentCommodityPrice
tools.description: Returns the current price for a single commodity (when `name` is provided) or a list of commodities (when `names` is provided). Optional `currency` and `unit` parameters convert the response from the native USD/USX quote into any supported currency and unit.

tools.name: getCommoditySpotPrice
tools.description: Returns the spot price (the price for immediate delivery) for commodities that have a spot market: gold, silver, platinum, and palladium (composite: blended live market quotes, with bid/ask on premium plans) and WTI, Brent, natural gas, gasoline, and heating oil (assessed: the U.S. EIA official dail

tools.name: getHistoricalCommodityPrice
tools.description: Returns a historical price series for a commodity over an optional Unix start/end range and interval. Requires a `name`. For the latest price use /commodityprice.

tools.name: getCommoditySnapshot
tools.description: Returns an enriched price object for all 30 supported commodities on every plan, including the free tier. Free responses carry the last completed daily settlement; premium plans return the live price. Optional filters narrow the result set.

tools.name: getCommodityContract
tools.description: Returns price information for a specific commodity contract or all contracts matching a commodity root. Either symbol or symbol_root must be provided, but not both.

tools.name: getCommodityContractList
tools.description: Returns a list of all available commodity contracts with their symbols and commodity names. This endpoint is useful for discovering which contracts are available for querying.

tools.name: getCommodityForwardCurve
tools.description: Returns every active futures contract for the requested commodity, sorted by contract month, along with a contango/backwardation classification and 1-month and ~12-month percent slopes. Reserved for Business, Professional, and annual-subscription tiers.

tools.name: convertCurrency
tools.description: Converts an `amount` from one currency to another. Requires `have`, `want` and `amount`. For the raw rate without converting a figure use /exchangerate.

tools.name: getCounter
tools.description: Fetches a stored integer counter by `id`, optionally incrementing it with `hit` or setting it to a given `value`. Using a new id creates a new counter.

tools.name: getAllCountryFlags
tools.description: Returns flag image URLs for every supported country, territory and area. For one country's flag use /countryflag. Requires a premium subscription.

tools.name: getCountryFlag
tools.description: Returns URLs of one country's square and rectangle SVG flag images. Requires a 2-letter ISO-3166 alpha-2 `country` code. For URLs of all supported flags use /allcountryflags.

tools.name: getAllCountries
tools.description: Returns the 2-letter ISO codes of every supported country. For statistics about a specific country use /country. Requires a premium subscription.

tools.name: getCountryData
tools.description: Returns geographic, demographic, and economic statistics for countries matching filters such as name, currency, GDP, population, area, or unemployment rate.

tools.name: getCounty
tools.description: Returns details for one or more counties matching the input parameters.

tools.name: getCovidData
tools.description: Returns Covid-19 case counts or deaths by country, administrative region, or US county, as a series or a single-day snapshot. Either `date` or `country` must be set.

tools.name: getCryptoPriceHistorical
tools.description: Returns historical OHLCV candles for a cryptocurrency at a chosen interval and time range. Requires a `symbol` such as BTCUSD or ETHBTC. Symbols ending in USD are priced in real US dollars; other fiat quotes (e.g. BTCEUR) are not supported on this endpoint. For the live price use /cryptoprice.

tools.name: getCryptoPrice
tools.description: Returns the current market price of a cryptocurrency. Requires a `symbol` such as BTCUSD or ETHBTC. Symbols ending in USD are priced in real US dollars; symbols ending in USDT are priced in Tether, a stablecoin that is not exactly $1. Premium plans can also quote fiat currencies, e.g. BTCEUR, which

tools.name: getCryptoTreasury
tools.description: Crypto asset positions reported to the SEC in quarterly XBRL filings. Coverage is limited to SEC filers (holders listed only outside the US are not included), and each position is as of the filer's reported period end. With no parameters, returns the largest current positions ranked by dollar value.

tools.name: getCryptoSymbols
tools.description: Returns the list of cryptocurrency ticker symbols available. Use it to find valid symbols before requesting quotes from the Crypto Price API.

tools.name: getCurrencyVolatility
tools.description: Returns the latest realised volatility for a currency `pair`, with optional `window`, `method` and annualisation. For a time series use /currencyvolatilityhistorical.

tools.name: getCurrencyVolatilityHistorical
tools.description: Returns a realised volatility time series for a currency `pair` across a date range or `days` lookback. For the latest single value use /currencyvolatility.

tools.name: getCurrencyVolatilityForecast
tools.description: Projects forward volatility for a currency `pair` over a `horizon`, using EWMA or a comparable `method`. For realised values instead use /currencyvolatility.

tools.name: getDadJoke
tools.description: Returns one or more random dad jokes. The `limit` parameter, which returns up to 100 jokes in a call, is available on premium plans only.

tools.name: getDayInHistory
tools.description: Returns historical events that happened on a given `month` and `day`. Free requests cover today's date only; other dates plus `limit` and `offset` require premium.

tools.name: getDefinition
tools.description: Returns a string containing definitions for a given word.

tools.name: checkDisposableEmail
tools.description: Checks whether an email address comes from a disposable or temporary email provider, for sign-up and fraud screening. Requires `email`.

tools.name: getDNSRecords
tools.description: Retrieves DNS records for a domain, covering the A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, PTR, SRV, SOA, TXT and CAA record types. Requires `domain`.

tools.name: getDogs
tools.description: Returns dog breeds matching filters such as name, height, weight, life expectancy, shedding, barking, energy, or trainability. For breed names only use /alldogs.

tools.name: getAllDogs
tools.description: Returns the names of every dog breed in the database and no other fields. For breed traits and measurements such as height, weight, and shedding use /dogs.

tools.name: getDomainInfo
tools.description: Checks whether a domain is available and returns basic registration information. Requires a `domain`; top-level domains other than .com need a premium subscription.

tools.name: getEarningsCalendar
tools.description: Returns earnings reports for one company (`ticker`), one calendar date (`date`), or a date range (`date_start`/`date_end`). At least one of these is required, and `date` cannot be combined with a range. Covers 50,000+ tickers on US and international exchanges with history back to 2000. How far back

tools.name: getEarningsCalendarList
tools.description: Returns the list of companies covered by the earnings calendar. For a specific company's earnings results and reporting dates use /earningscalendar.

tools.name: getUpcomingEarnings
tools.description: Returns a list of upcoming earnings dates with filtering capabilities. You can filter by date range, single date, exchange, or ticker symbol. Results are limited to dates from today onwards. Premium only.

tools.name: getEarningsTranscript
tools.description: Returns the full text of one company's earnings call. Requires a `ticker` or `cik`; to find which calls exist first, use /earningstranscriptsearch. Choosing a `quarter` requires premium.

tools.name: listEarningsCallTranscripts
tools.description: Lists all available earnings call transcripts, paged with `limit` and `offset`. To filter by ticker, CIK or date use /earningstranscriptsearch; for the text of one call use /earningstranscript.

tools.name: searchEarningsTranscripts
tools.description: Finds which earnings call transcripts are available by ticker, CIK, date or date range, with paginated results. Returns the matching calls, not their text; read that from /earningstranscript.

tools.name: getEarningsCallSpeaker
tools.description: Searches earnings-call speakers by name, company, analyst firm, role or type, or returns one speaker's profile, coverage and appearance history when `id` is given.

tools.name: getEarningsCallParticipants
tools.description: Lists the executives and analysts who appeared on one company's earnings calls. Requires a `ticker` or `cik`. For a single person across companies use /earningstranscriptspeaker.

tools.name: getEarnings
tools.description: Returns reported earnings results, filtered by `ticker`, `cik`, `year`, `quarter` or filing `date`. For dates of upcoming reports use /earningscalendar.

tools.name: getElectricVehicleData
tools.description: Returns electric vehicle records with range, battery, charging, and performance data, filtered by make, model, year, or range. For maker names use /electricvehiclemakes.

tools.name: getElectricVehicleMakes
tools.description: Returns the list of electric vehicle manufacturers, optionally filtered by year. For the models of one manufacturer use /electricvehiclemodels.

tools.name: getElectricVehicleModels
tools.description: Returns all electric vehicle models for one manufacturer, optionally filtered by year. Requires a `make`. For full vehicle specs use /electricvehicle.

tools.name: encodeText
tools.description: Encodes any given text into a 768-dimensional vector using state-of-the-art NLP machine learning models.

tools.name: getEmojis
tools.description: Returns a list of emojis according to input parameters. Returns at most 30 results. To access more than 30 results, use the offset parameter to offset results in multiple API calls.

tools.name: getETFInfo
tools.description: Returns holdings, expense ratio, assets under management and trailing total-return performance for one ETF. Look it up by `ticker`, or by `isin` to get the fund's most-traded listing. `listings` lists every exchange the same fund trades on. To find or enumerate ETFs use /etfsearch or /etflist.

tools.name: listETFs
tools.description: Returns ETF ticker symbols supported by the ETF API, paginated up to 1000 per call. Increment the offset parameter by 1000 until fewer than 1000 results are returned to walk the entire list. Available to Business, Professional, or annual subscribers only.

tools.name: searchETFs
tools.description: Search for ETFs by name, AUM, expense ratio, holdings, or country. Results are sorted by AUM descending and paginated 50 per page. At least one filter parameter is required. Available to Business, Professional, or annual subscribers only.

tools.name: getEuriborRates
tools.description: Returns current Euribor interbank lending rates for maturities from 1 week to 12 months. Takes no parameters.

tools.name: getEVCharger
tools.description: Get electric vehicle charging stations near a location specified by latitude and longitude coordinates.

tools.name: getExchangeRate
tools.description: Returns the current exchange rate for a currency `pair` such as USD_EUR. To convert a specific amount instead use /convertcurrency.

tools.name: getHistoricalExchangeRate
tools.description: Returns daily historical exchange rates for a given currency pair. Data is available from 1999-01-01 onward. Provide either a single date or a start_date/end_date range (max 366 days). Premium subscription required.

tools.name: getExecutiveCompensation
tools.description: Returns named-executive-officer compensation for a company, sourced from SEC DEF 14A proxy statements, plus the structured Pay Versus Performance disclosure. The free tier returns the CEO's total for the latest fiscal year; premium tiers unlock the full breakdown, all executives, historical years, a

tools.name: getExercises
tools.description: Returns up to 5 exercises that satisfy the given parameters.

tools.name: getAllExercises
tools.description: Returns a comprehensive list of exercises that target a specific muscle group. Available on Business, Professional, or annual subscriptions only.

tools.name: detectFaces
tools.description: Runs computer-vision face detection on an image supplied in the POST request body and returns the faces found. Takes no query parameters.

tools.name: getFacts
tools.description: Returns one or more random facts. Free users have access to 100 facts - premium users have access to over 125,000 facts.

tools.name: getFactOfTheDay
tools.description: Returns a single fact for the current day. The same fact is returned for all requests on the same day, and changes each day. No parameters are available for this endpoint, so everyone sees the same fact of the day.

tools.name: getGDPData
tools.description: Get GDP data from given parameters. Returns GDP statistics that satisfy the parameters.

tools.name: getGeocoding
tools.description: Converts a place name into latitude and longitude. Requires `city`; narrow with `state`, `country` or `zipcode`. For the reverse direction use /reversegeocoding.

tools.name: getReverseGeocoding
tools.description: Converts a `lat` and `lon` pair into the matching place name and administrative area. For the opposite direction use /geocoding.

tools.name: getCurrentGoldPrice
tools.description: Returns the current gold futures price in USD. Free responses carry the last completed daily settlement; premium plans return the live price.

tools.name: getGoldSpotPrice
tools.description: Returns the gold spot price (XAU/USD), blended from multiple live market quotes. Free tier returns the last daily close; premium tiers return the live price with bid and ask.

tools.name: getHistoricalGoldPrice
tools.description: Returns historical gold futures price data in OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) format. The data is returned in descending order (most recent first), and all prices are in USD. Premium subscribers only.

tools.name: getHelicopterData
tools.description: Returns technical specifications for helicopter models, filtered by manufacturer, model, or ranges of air speed, range, length, and height.

tools.name: getHistoricalEvents
tools.description: Searches famous events in history by keyword `text` and/or `year`, `month` and `day`; negative years mean BC. Pagination with `offset` requires premium.

tools.name: searchHistoricalFigures
tools.description: Searches notable people from history, ancient to modern, by name with partial matches supported, and returns their records. Requires `name`.

tools.name: getHobby
tools.description: Returns a random hobby suggestion, optionally restricted to a `category` such as general, sports_and_outdoors or education.

tools.name: getHolidays
tools.description: Returns holidays for a country and calendar year, optionally filtered by holiday type. Requires a `country`. For holidays falling on one date use /v1/isholiday.

tools.name: isHoliday
tools.description: Returns all holidays that fall on a given date, optionally restricted to one country. Requires a `date`. For a full year's calendar use /v2/holidays.

tools.name: getHoroscope
tools.description: Returns the daily horoscope for one zodiac sign. An optional `date` in YYYY-MM-DD format gives a past day's horoscope; future dates are not accepted.

tools.name: getHospitals
tools.description: Returns US hospitals matching a name, city, state, ZIP code, county or latitude/longitude bounding box, with location, contact information and bed count.

tools.name: getIBAN
tools.description: Validates an International Bank Account Number and returns the bank and account details encoded in it. Requires an `iban`.

tools.name: extractTextFromImage
tools.description: Given an input image, return all detected texts and their bounding boxes.

tools.name: getIncomeStatement
tools.description: Returns income statement data from SEC 10-Q and 10-K filings for one company, fiscal period and year. Requires `ticker` or `cik`. For available periods use /incomestatementavailability.

tools.name: getIncomeStatementAvailability
tools.description: Returns the fiscal years and quarters for which income statement data is available for a company. Requires a premium subscription (Developer tier and above).

tools.name: calculateIncomeTax
tools.description: Calculates income tax for the United States or Canada from income, location, and filing status, including state or provincial tax. Requires `country`, `region`, `income`.

tools.name: calculatePaycheckWithholding
tools.description: Premium only. Returns per-paycheck federal withholding, FICA (Social Security, Medicare, Additional Medicare), and optional state withholding given gross pay and W-4 inputs. Supports both the 2020-or-later and pre-2020 W-4 forms. Requires `gross_pay`, `pay_period`, `filing_status`.

tools.name: getIncomeTax
tools.description: Returns comprehensive income tax information including tax brackets and rates at both federal and state/provincial levels (where applicable).

tools.name: getCurrentInflation
tools.description: Returns current monthly and annual inflation percentages. Premium subscribers only.

tools.name: getHistoricalInflation
tools.description: Returns historical inflation rates for a given country and (optionally) time range. The maximum number of data points returned per API call is 100. Premium subscribers only.

tools.name: getInsiderTransactions
tools.description: Returns a list of insider trading transactions that match the specified filters. Returns at most 100 results per request. For more results, use the offset parameter. Results are limited by filing date to the plan's history window: Free returns filings from the last 90 days, Developer the last 2 year

tools.name: getInsiderDetails
tools.description: Returns detailed transaction information for a given insider with optional filtering by company. Returns a maximum of 10 transactions, ordered by filing date (most recent first). Premium subscriptions only.

tools.name: getInsidersList
tools.description: Returns a list of all insiders for a given company (via ticker or CIK). For each insider, returns their name, position, and current share holdings based on their most recent filing. Either ticker or CIK is required. Premium subscriptions only.

tools.name: getInstitutionalHoldings
tools.description: Returns an institutional manager's full 13F portfolio for a quarter. Requires `cik` or `manager_name`. For every holder of a single stock use /institutionalownership.

tools.name: getInstitutionalOwnership
tools.description: Lists every institution holding a given stock in a quarter. Requires `ticker` or `cusip`. For one manager's entire portfolio use /institutionalholdings.

tools.name: getInstitutionalInvestors
tools.description: Searches the directory of 13F-filing institutions by name, CIK or quarter and returns their filing history rather than positions. Requires a premium subscription.

tools.name: getInstitutionalMovers
tools.description: Ranks the largest institutional new buys, exits, adds or trims for a quarter, market-wide or within one institution. Requires a premium subscription.

tools.name: getCurrentInterestRates
tools.description: Returns the latest published value of a central bank or benchmark `rate`. For the full history of that rate use /historicalinterestrates.

tools.name: getHistoricalInterestRates
tools.description: Returns the published history of a benchmark `rate` over an optional date range, given as `start_date`/`end_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) or `start_time`/`end_time` (UNIX seconds). For the latest value only use /interestrate.

tools.name: getIPInfo
tools.description: Returns location information for an IP address. Requires an `address` in IPv4 form such as 73.9.149.180 or in IPv6 form.

tools.name: getIpoCalendar
tools.description: Returns a list of IPO records matching the supplied filters. With no parameters, returns IPOs with listing dates between today and 30 days from now. All parameters are optional; combine them to narrow results by ticker, CIK, date range, status, deal type, exchange, or industry.

tools.name: getJoke
tools.description: Returns random jokes about pop culture, science, history and other topics. Set `limit` to return between 1 and 100 jokes; the default is 1.

tools.name: getJokeOfTheDay
tools.description: Returns a single joke for the current day. The same joke is returned for all requests on the same day, and changes each day. No parameters are available for this endpoint, so everyone sees the same joke of the day.

tools.name: getHistoricalLiborRates
tools.description: Returns historical LIBOR rates for one tenor over an optional Unix timestamp range. Requires `type`: overnight, 1_month, 3_months, 6_months or 12_months.

tools.name: getLogos
tools.description: Get a list of company names, ticker symbols, and logo image URLs matching the input parameters. Returns at most 10 results.

tools.name: generateLoremIpsum
tools.description: Returns one or more paragraphs of lorem ipsum placeholder text.

tools.name: getLotteryDraw
tools.description: Returns the latest draw for a game, the draw on a given date, or the latest draw of every game in a US state or a country. On paid plans results usually appear within minutes of the official publication; on the free plan they appear about 60 minutes later. Provide game, state or country. Returns a J

tools.name: getLotteryHistoricalDraws
tools.description: Returns past draws for a game, newest first. The free plan gets the latest 10 draws (each visible about 60 minutes after the draw); Developer plans a rolling two years; Business tier and above the full archive.

tools.name: listLotteryGames
tools.description: Lists the covered games with their number format, draw schedule, jackpot odds, prize tiers, rule-change history and archive range.

tools.name: checkLotteryTicket
tools.description: Premium only. Scores a ticket against a draw and returns the matched prize tier and prize. Supports Powerball (with Power Play and Double Play), Mega Millions (with the ticket's built-in multiplier) and Millionaire for Life. Ticket numbers are never stored. The result is not a prize claim.

tools.name: listLotteryJackpots
tools.description: Premium only. Lists the next advertised jackpot for every active game that publishes one, largest first within each currency.

tools.name: getMarketCap
tools.description: Returns real-time market capitalization data for a company listed on a major exchange. Requires a `ticker` such as NVDA.

tools.name: getCurrentMetalsPrice
tools.description: Returns the current spot price of a metal with its futures price and contract. Free tier returns the last daily close for every metal; Developer plans get a spot price refreshed every minute; Business, Professional, and Enterprise plans get the live spot price (about every 10 seconds) and the metals

tools.name: calculateMortgage
tools.description: Calculates monthly and annual mortgage payments and interest from a loan amount or home value and downpayment, plus optional HOA, tax and insurance. Requires `interest_rate`.

tools.name: getMortgageRate
tools.description: Returns 30-year and 15-year fixed-rate mortgage (FRM) data. If no parameters are set, the mortgage rate data for the most recent day is returned.

tools.name: getMotorCarrier
tools.description: Canonical carrier profile. Provide exactly one of dot or mc.

tools.name: searchMotorCarriers
tools.description: Find carriers by name, location or status, or reverse-look-up by phone or email (Business+).

tools.name: getMotorCarrierInsurance
tools.description: Business+ only. Policy-level filings with coverage in US dollars, plus the 30-day BMC-35 cancellation window.

tools.name: getMotorCarrierSafety
tools.description: Crash counts, out-of-service rates against the national average, and public BASIC measures.

tools.name: getMotorCarrierLinks

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: searchEarningsTranscripts, getLogos, searchSEC · Private data: getAllCatNames, getCelebrity, getDNSRecords, getAllDogs, getElectricVehicleData, searchHistoricalFigures, getHospitals, getIpoCalendar, getMXRecords, generatePassword, getQuoteAuthors, getSalesTaxFiling, getStockSplit, getTicker · Public sink: getCurrencyVolatilityForecast, checkDisposableEmail, detectFaces, getInsidersList, searchMotorCarriers, getMXRecords, detectObjects, getRandomUsers, getSalesTaxFiling, getStockSplit, validateEmail, getWhois · Destructive: generateBarcode, getHistoricalGoldPrice, getHoroscope, listLotteryGames, phoneLookup, validatePhone, validateVATNumber.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: searchEarningsTranscripts, getLogos, searchSEC · Private data: getAllCatNames, getCelebrity, getDNSRecords, getAllDogs, getElectricVehicleData, searchHistoricalFigures, getHospitals, getIpoCalendar, getMXRecords, generatePassword, getQuoteAuthors, getSalesTaxFiling, getStockSplit, getTicker · Public sink: getCurrencyVolatilityForecast, checkDisposableEmail, detectFaces, getInsidersList, searchMotorCarriers, getMXRecords, detectObjects, getRandomUsers, getSalesTaxFiling, getStockSplit, validateEmail, getWhois · Destructive: generateBarcode, getHistoricalGoldPrice, getHoroscope, listLotteryGames, phoneLookup, validatePhone, validateVATNumber

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
